answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 24919 Country: India Title: Is it possible for mother feeding while fasting? Question: Is it possible for mother feeding while fasting? Answer ID: 24919 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1320/1320/M=1431) Yes, she can breastfeed. It does not invalidate the fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
